housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of AUD 2,500 per month for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Darwin. Northern Territory guidance caps the security deposit at four weeks' rent, represented here as 1 month: https://nt.gov.au/property/private-renters/find-out-about-rental-costs/security-deposits-bonds. Domain provides Darwin City rental listings: https://www.domain.com.au/rent/darwin-city-nt-0800/.

banking.summary: CommBank's migrant account page requires a current passport, entry-visa information, foreign tax-residency TINs, and an Australian residential address for full access after in-branch identification: https://www.commbank.com.au/moving-to-australia/banking.html. Westpac's official new-arrivals page supports Westpac as a newcomer option and asks for a mobile number, email, arrival date, Australian address, foreign tax number, and valid ID for activation: https://www.westpac.com.au/international-travel/new-to-australia/choice-new-arrivals/.
required_docs: Tax Identification Number for each country of foreign tax residency
Australian residential address for full account access

schools.summary: Good Shepherd Lutheran College in the Darwin area states that it is an IB World School offering the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme: https://goodshepherd.nt.edu.au/our-schools. The Northern Territory Government's Darwin-region list links to the official education directory for government and non-government schools: https://nt.gov.au/learning/primary-and-secondary-students/list-of-urban-and-remote-schools.

legal_admin.summary: On arrival, travellers must show a valid passport or travel document and complete and show an Incoming Passenger Card; the card requirement applies to most passengers, subject to prescribed exemptions: https://www.abf.gov.au/entering-and-leaving-australia/crossing-the-border/at-the-border/incoming-passenger-card-(ipc).
legal_admin.registration_step: Present a valid passport or travel document and complete and show an Incoming Passenger Card at the Australian border; prescribed exemptions apply.

tax_finance.summary: The Australian tax identifier is the Tax File Number (TFN). A permanent migrant or temporary visitor who is in Australia with a valid work-rights visa linked to their passport or travel document can apply online through Individual Auto-Registration; the ATO specifies alternative resident or paper routes when IAR is unavailable: https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/tax-file-number/apply-for-a-tfn/foreign-passport-holders-permanent-migrants-and-temporary-visitors-tfn-application.

transport.summary: CDC Northern Territory operates public bus services in Darwin, Palmerston and rural areas for the Northern Territory Government: https://cdcnorthernterritory.com.au/travel-info/timetables-and-maps/. NT Government says Greater Darwin public buses are currently free, so no monthly-pass fare is published: https://nt.gov.au/driving/public-transport-cycling/public-buses/fares. New NT residents must transfer an overseas licence within 3 months; recognised-country licences can transfer without theory and practical tests, while others must complete those tests: https://nt.gov.au/driving/licence/new-nt-residents-and-visitors/transfer-your-overseas-licence. Eligible Australian permanent residents can enrol in Medicare online through myGov or with the enrolment form and need to live in Australia, hold a current passport or ImmiCard, and have valid Home Affairs visa details: https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/enrolling-medicare-if-youre-australian-permanent-resident?context=60092.
transport.network_name: Darwin and Palmerston public bus services (CDC Northern Territory)
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Transfer an overseas licence within 3 months of living in the Northern Territory. Recognised-country licences can transfer without theory and practical tests; other applicants must pass the required theory and practical tests.
transport.healthcare_registration: If eligible as an Australian permanent resident, enrol in Medicare online through myGov or submit the Medicare enrolment form; applicants must live in Australia and provide a current passport or ImmiCard plus valid Home Affairs visa details.
